name: PocketBase
tagline: Open-source backend in a single file
description: PocketBase is a single-file backend with a built-in admin UI, authentication, file storage, and a realtime API. You get an instant database-backed API with zero configuration, and it ships as one static executable. Perfect for prototypes, side projects, and small production apps that want to avoid backend boilerplate.
highlights: Auth, file storage, and realtime subscriptions included
Admin UI generated from your collections
curatorNote: PocketBase removes the boring part of building a backend. For a solo developer, the time saved between idea and working API is remarkable.
